# OpenBMC message registry

`OpenBMC.0.5.0.json` is `redfish-core/include/registries/openbmc.json` of bmcweb
(<https://github.com/openbmc/bmcweb>, commit `3cdd1fa`, 2026-11-15), copied without changes. It is distributed under
the Apache License 2.0; the licence is in [LICENSE](LICENSE), and the copyright line is the file's own.

The tests read it as an OpenBMC service would serve it under `/redfish/v1/Registries/OpenBMC/OpenBMC`.
